chart.title: Share of countries by gender of the chief executive
chart.subtitle: "Chief executive" is defined here as the head of state or the head of government, whoever has more power over the appointment and dismissal of cabinet ministers.
chart.note: This is recorded on December 31 of each year. When the head of state and head of government hold equal power, the head of government is considered the chief executive.

Number of countries in which chief execu.descriptionProcessing: We only count the countries that V-Dem covers in the given year. Where we impute a country's data from a historical entity it was part of, those imputed values are excluded from the count, because the country did not yet exist separately at the time.
